description: Unified search across tickets, users, organizations and groups using Zendesk search syntax. Examples: `type:ticket status:open`, `type:user email:jane@acme.com`, `type:organization name:acme`. Zendesk REST: GET /search.json.

query.description: Zendesk search query, e.g. 'type:ticket status:open priority:high' (required).

sort_order.description: Sort direction: asc or desc (default desc).

name: zendesk_search
title: Search
